{{Quote|I don't have much information regarding the Mokk stronghold ''[sic]'' other than the fact that the Mokk are a Dantari tribe. The stronghold can be found on Dantooine around the northwestern edge of the planet. The Rebels have been known to interact with these primitives, and we believe this is where they may have planned Dr. Bledsoe's abduction.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Colonel Darkstone"}}</ref>}}
The '''Mokk Stronghold''' was a fortified [[Dantari]] settlement located in the [[Mosa Rishin]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:MS" /> The tribal leader of the [[Mokk]] and many other members of the tribe resided in.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|All I need to know is if some Dantari are using it. I've heard a tribe named the Mokk Dantari are using it, but I need to make sure.|[[Daiv Dekven]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Daiv Dekven|Dantooine}}</ref>}}
[[File:MokkStrongholdWarriors.jpg|250px|thumb|Two Mokk warriors at the stronghold]]
During the Galactic Civil War, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] interacted with the Mokk several times, presumably also including having access to the stronghold.<ref name="SWG:CD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] suspected the Mokk Stronghold to be the location where the Rebels made their plans to abduct [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]], an Imperial scientist. These details were the reason why it acted as one of three possible locations of a prison transfer log that [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]] dispatched an Imperial unit to retrieve a prison transfer log in an attempt to rescue the doctor, the others being the [[Palace of the Woolamander]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and the [[Droid Engineer's Cave|Droid Engineer cave]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:CD" />

The same year, the Rebel [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Daiv Dekven]] tasked a spacer with exploring the stronghold.<ref name="SWG:DD" /> Later, a spacer visited the stronghold and collected an [[eventide smasher]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMIV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mokk Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
